unit.why: A short narrative about the wedding of Rebbetzin Reizel and R. Shalom Yosef of Ruzhin, where R. Itzikl of Radzivil delays the huppah until his late father, the Maggid, arrives from the Garden of Eden.
unit.boundary_note: division opens with a genealogical introduction of R. Yitzhak of Buhusz; it ends with a section heading ('חידושים ומאמרים מתוקים ממנו הקדוש') that introduces the next division's teachings

stories.start_quote: הנה נודע ומפורסם כי בעת הי' הנישואין
stories.end_quote: אביו הק׳ מן גן עדנו הנה בא
stories.summary_en: At the wedding of R. Itzikl of Radzivil's granddaughter Reizel to the son of R. Israel of Ruzhin, R. Itzikl refuses to begin the huppah, though the Ruzhiner urges him that the day is passing, until he sees his late father, the holy Maggid, come from the Garden of Eden to attend.
